aboutMe.profile:
A 19-year-old who loves creating things.
Started out with web development using Next.js and Ruby on Rails, and is now participating in a wide range of engineering internships—from web frontend to mobile and backend development.
Whether it's building apps, filleting fish, or making sweets, I have a wide variety of hobbies.
My life motto is: 'Live joyfully!!'
